<div class="review-text">
Horribly buggy and presenting a low production quality, Tale of the Dragon was made with none of the design sense of the original game from Ensemble Studios. This adds practically nothing functional or even mechanically interesting to the game; it is loaded with oversights, cheap reskinnings, and instability.
